install_tell: Hosted SaaS, API-first. Per-agent persistent inbox; REST send/receive/thread/search + MCP. YC S2025; $6M seed (General Catalyst, Mar 2026; angels PG, Dharmesh Shah). Team ~10.
misconfig_patterns: Outbound guard is claim-stage: blurb cites secret/API-key/PII scan + human-approval routing for blocked sends, plus a 10/day unverified-account send cap. NOT verified at the data layer (surface-claimed, not exercised).
Substrate risk: an agent given inbox + send + tool-use is the Lethal-Trifecta surface; content safety is punted upstream to the caller unless the outbound guard is real and enabled.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Anchor on apex agentmail.to + 'agents'/'inbox' co-occurrence. Disambiguate from agenticmail.com (OSS, separate) and agenticmail.io (unrelated agent-workforce product).

deployment_tells: API-first; web app + docs at agentmail.to. Cloudflare-fronted likely (verify).
MCP-compatible; positions as the 'inbox for agents' substrate, not a guardrail.
pivot_paths: Public docs expose REST contract (/v0/inboxes, /v0/messages) -> map surface without probing.
Domain disambiguation pivot: agentmail.to (YC S25 funded) vs agenticmail.com (OSS) vs agenticmail.io (unrelated).
Outbound-scan claim is the verification target: confirm whether secret/PII scan is real code or marketing before assigning category-core status.

competitive_lane.lane: B (API gateway) + agentic-mail substrate; outbound-safety ADJACENT (feature, not core)
competitive_lane.differentiator: Category flagship by funding/visibility, but core product is per-agent inbox infra; outbound guard is a bolt-on feature claim.

sources: outbound-scan feature [CANDIDATE — sourced to YC/press blurb, NOT verified at data layer]
founders: Haakam Aujla, Michael Kim, Adi Singh (U Michigan / ex-Optiver/Nvidia/Accel, SF)
lineage_verdict: SEPARATE from AgenticMail (agenticmail.com). Same market category, different founders/infra/trajectory. Name overlap = category convergence, not fork.

shodan_infrastructure.infrastructure_notes: AWS GlobalAccelerator for global SMTP/IMAP anycast. smtp.agentmail.to on ports 465+587; imap.agentmail.to on port 993. Multi-IP anycast pair per service. Operator hardened (AWS-managed infra, no self-hosted exposure). Cloudflare likely fronts the web API; SMTP/IMAP nodes visible directly.
